image_description: A close-up photograph of a pinkish-purple coral fungus (likely Ramaria or Clavaria species) growing on a forest floor among dry brown leaves, green moss, and long green blades of grass. The fungus features multiple upright, cylindrical branches arising from a common base, with some branches bifurcating near the tips. The lighting is natural, casting soft shadows.
